scope: Read-only evidence audit of prior import geometry; no historical scripts edited. Recommendations are for root's canonical alignment specification.

inference: The offset was propagated through preserved silhouette and portrait-specific per-part frames, then treated as accepted old geometry. Existing engineering checks proved resource integrity and reconstruction fidelity, so the missing independent final-face-axis and bilateral-shape acceptance allowed the error to persist. Source rotation alone cannot explain all visible left/right shape differences; generated/source painted anatomy must be reviewed separately.
prevention_inputs_for_root: One versioned fixed-face semantic template, anchored to unchanged face_shape01 hash and actual forehead/cheek/jaw landmarks. Common axisx513 is independent of feature Alpha bounds.
Measure final PNG pupil kernels, actual eye joins/iris-level upper-lower lids, brow heads/crests/tails, nostril dark-hole midpoint and lip seam after every sampling/cleanup step.
Pair symmetry and common center are separate gates: a level pupil pair can still have unequal eye fissures or brow arches, and equal shapes can still be off-center.
Source-to-native fit residual is separate from final-template residual. Keep source identity, explicit matrices and final semantic QA evidence together.
Unoccluded normal-size front view plus hair/cloth/beard mix views are required before installation; runtime combination counts cannot replace that review.
Do not inherit the old04/05 source-to-frame matrix or retiredrig x517/y379 in new imports. Register generated pairs directly into the canonical current-face frame.
